_about: Water (1) + ethyl acetate (2): mutual solubilities (liquid-liquid equilibrium) at 298.2 K, binary data from Cehreli, Ozmen and Dramur (2006). Phase I is the water-rich phase, phase II the ester-rich phase. Rows as in the ThermoML Archive record: T in K, mole fraction of water in phase I, mole fraction of water in phase II.

source.citation: S. Cehreli, D. Ozmen, U. Dramur, (Liquid + liquid) equilibria of (water + 1-propanol + solvent) at T = 298.2 K, Fluid Phase Equilibria 239 (2006) 156-160
source.access: Journal article is subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 4 (mole fraction of water in liquid mixture 1) and 5 (mole fraction of water in liquid mixture 2), compounds 2 ethyl acetate and 3 water. The table number in the article was not checked (article not open).

notes: Pressure 101.32 kPa in the record. No uncertainty given in the record. Read twice from the ThermoML Archive (XML and JSON files), both reads identical.
